Native content supports text color, background color and font styling; use EPUB rendering for complex styles such as image bubbles and nine-grid layouts.

Select a local .red highlight rule file to import. Duplicate rules are skipped automatically and unreadable files report the reason.

Global rules apply to every book; single-book rules are bound to the book open at import time. If no book is open, bind it later under "Scope". Reeden book IDs are not used directly as local book IDs.

Rules stack in list order. Only body text is matched; the original text, bookmarks and read-aloud content are not rewritten. Title rules may leave the match text empty to match the whole title.

Only the RED01 format is supported. Some .red files use Reeden's AES-encrypted wrapper, which cannot be read yet; this does not mean you or the rule author set a password. Reeden fonts that are not bundled fall back to the current reading font.
